items.source: as of 6.1, in favor of the "autodetect" flag
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，推荐使用"autodetect" 标志。

items.source: Set the NotificationListenerBeans containing the NotificationListeners that will be registered with the MBeanServer.
items.translation: 设置包含将注册到 MBeanServer 的 NotificationListeners 的 NotificationListenerBeans。

items.source: This callback is only required for resolution of bean names in the "beans" Map and for auto-detection of MBeans (in the latter case, a ListableBeanFactory is required).
items.translation: 此回调仅在解析 `"beans" Map 中的 Bean 名称以及自动检测 MBeans（在后一种情况下，需要 `ListableBeanFactory`）时是必需的。

items.source: managedResource - the resource to expose via JMX
items.translation: managedResource - 要通过 JMX 暴露的资源

items.source: The key of each entry in the Map is a String representation of the ObjectName or the bean name of the MBean the listener should be registered for. Specifying an asterisk (*) for a key will cause the listener to be associated with all MBeans registered by this class at startup time.
items.translation: Map 中每个条目的键是 String 形式的 ObjectName 或 MBean 的 bean 名称，监听器应为此 MBean 注册。为键指定星号（*）将导致该监听器与此类在启动时注册的所有 MBean 关联。

items.source: The value of each entry is the NotificationListener to register. For more advanced options such as registering NotificationFilters and handback objects see setNotificationListeners(NotificationListenerBean[]).
items.translation: 每个条目的值是用于注册的 `NotificationListener`。对于更高级的选项，例如注册 `NotificationFilters` 和回传对象，请参阅 `setNotificationListeners(NotificationListenerBean[])`。

items.source: This method is responsible for deciding how a bean should be exposed to the MBeanServer. Specifically, if the supplied mapValue is the name of a bean that is configured for lazy initialization, then a proxy to the resource is registered with the MBeanServer so that the lazy load behavior is honored. If the bean is already an MBean then it will be registered directly with the MBeanServer without any intervention. For all other beans or bean names, the resource itself is registered with the MBeanServer directly.
items.translation: 此方法负责决定如何将 Bean 暴露给 `MBeanServer`。具体而言，如果提供的 `mapValue` 是配置为延迟初始化的 Bean 的名称，则会向 `MBeanServer` 注册该资源的代理，以遵循延迟加载行为。如果 Bean 已经是 MBean，则将其直接注册到 `MBeanServer`，无需任何干预。对于所有其他 Bean 或 Bean 名称，资源本身将直接注册到 `MBeanServer`。

items.source: The default value is true, exposing a SpringModelMBean which performs thread context ClassLoader management. Switch this flag off to expose a standard JMX RequiredModelMBean.
items.translation: 默认值为 `true`，会暴露一个执行线程上下文 ClassLoader 管理的 SpringModelMBean。关闭此标志以暴露标准的 JMX RequiredModelMBean。

items.source: Each bean is exposed to the MBeanServer via a ModelMBean. The actual implementation of the ModelMBean interface used depends on the implementation of the ModelMBeanProvider interface that is configured. By default, the RequiredModelMBean class that is supplied with all JMX implementations is used.
items.translation: 每个 Bean 都通过一个 `ModelMBean` 暴露给 `MBeanServer`。实际使用的 `ModelMBean` 接口实现取决于配置的 `ModelMBeanProvider` 接口的实现。默认情况下，使用随所有 JMX 实现提供的 `RequiredModelMBean` 类。

items.source: A list of MBeanExporterListeners can be registered via the listeners property, allowing application code to be notified of MBean registration and unregistration events.
items.translation: 可以注册一个 `MBeanExporterListeners` 列表，通过 `listeners` 属性实现，从而允许应用程序代码接收 MBean 注册和注销事件的通知。

items.source: If the bean implements the SelfNaming interface, then the ObjectName will be retrieved using SelfNaming.getObjectName(). Otherwise, the configured ObjectNamingStrategy is used.
items.translation: 如果该 Bean 实现了 `SelfNaming` 接口，则使用 `SelfNaming.getObjectName()` 获取 `ObjectName`。否则，将使用配置的 `ObjectNamingStrategy`。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to JmxUtils.isMBean(Class), which checks for DynamicMBean classes as well as classes with corresponding "*MBean" interface (Standard MBeans) or corresponding "*MXBean" interface (Java MXBeans).
items.translation: 默认实现委托给 JmxUtils.isMBean(Class)，该方法会检查是否为 DynamicMBean 类，以及具有相应 "*MBean" 接口（标准 MBeans）或相应 "*MXBean" 接口（Java MXBeans）的类。

items.source: Please note that if an MBeanExporterListener throws a (runtime) exception when notified, this will essentially interrupt the notification process and any remaining listeners that have yet to be notified will not (obviously) receive the MBeanExporterListener.mbeanRegistered(javax.management.ObjectName) callback.
items.translation: 请注意，如果 `MBeanExporterListener` 在收到通知时抛出（运行时）异常，这实际上会中断通知过程，任何尚未收到通知的剩余监听器显然将不会接收到 MBeanExporterListener.mbeanRegistered(javax.management.ObjectName) 回调。

items.source: Please note that if an MBeanExporterListener throws a (runtime) exception when notified, this will essentially interrupt the notification process and any remaining listeners that have yet to be notified will not (obviously) receive the MBeanExporterListener.mbeanUnregistered(javax.management.ObjectName) callback.
items.translation: 请注意，如果 `MBeanExporterListener` 在收到通知时抛出（运行时）异常，这实际上会中断通知过程，任何尚未收到通知的剩余监听器显然将不会接收到 MBeanExporterListener.mbeanUnregistered(javax.management.ObjectName) 回调。

items.source: The management interface produced for each bean is dependent on the MBeanInfoAssembler implementation being used. The ObjectName given to each bean is dependent on the implementation of the ObjectNamingStrategy interface being used.
items.translation: 为每个 Bean 生成的管理接口取决于所使用的 `MBeanInfoAssembler` 实现。分配给每个 Bean 的 `ObjectName` 取决于所使用的 `ObjectNamingStrategy` 接口的实现。

items.source: If a bean does not implement one of the JMX management interfaces, MBeanExporter will create the management information using the supplied MBeanInfoAssembler.
items.translation: 如果某个 Bean 未实现 JMX 管理接口之一，MBeanExporter 将使用提供的 MBeanInfoAssembler 创建管理信息。

items.source: The String keys are the basis for the creation of JMX object names. By default, a JMX ObjectName will be created straight from the given key. This can be customized through specifying a custom NamingStrategy.
items.translation: String 键是创建 JMX 对象名的基础。默认情况下，JMX ObjectName 将直接从给定的键创建。可以通过指定自定义的 NamingStrategy 来定制此行为。

items.source: This method is called to obtain a ModelMBean instance to use when registering a bean. This method is called once per bean during the registration phase and must return a new instance of ModelMBean
items.translation: 此方法用于在注册 Bean 时获取一个ModelMBean实例。在注册阶段，此方法会为每个 Bean 调用一次，并且必须返回一个新的ModelMBean实例。

items.source: This feature is turned off by default. Explicitly specify true here to enable auto-detection.
items.translation: 此功能默认处于关闭状态。请在此处显式指定 `true` 以启用自动检测。

items.source: The passed-in assembler can optionally implement the AutodetectCapableMBeanInfoAssembler interface, which enables it to participate in the exporter's MBean auto-detection process.
items.translation: 传入的装配器可以可选地实现`AutodetectCapableMBeanInfoAssembler`接口，使其能够参与导出器的 MBean 自动检测过程。

items.source: The default value is true.
items.translation: 默认值为true。

items.source:
If a bean implements one of the JMX management interfaces, MBeanExporter can
simply register the MBean with the server through its auto-detection process.
items.translation: 如果某个 Bean 实现了 JMX 管理接口之一，MBeanExporter 可以通过其自动检测过程简单地将该 MBean 注册到服务器。

items.source: This exporter is compatible with MBeans as well as MXBeans.
items.translation: 该导出器同时兼容 MBeans 和 MXBeans。

items.source:
Both bean instances and bean names are allowed as values.
Bean instances are typically linked in through bean references.
Bean names will be resolved as beans in the current factory, respecting
lazy-init markers (that is, not triggering initialization of such beans).
items.translation:
bean 实例和 bean 名称都允许作为值。
bean 实例通常通过 bean 引用链接进来。
bean 名称将在当前工厂中解析为 bean，并尊重懒加载标记（即不会触发此类 bean 的初始化）。

items.source:
Default is "false", respecting lazy-init flags on bean definitions.
Switch this to "true" in order to search lazy-init beans as well,
including FactoryBean-produced objects that haven't been initialized yet.
items.translation: 默认为"false"，尊重 Bean 定义上的懒初始化标志。将此选项切换为"true"以搜索懒初始化的 Bean，包括尚未初始化的 FactoryBean 生成的对象。
默认实现会在存在 AOP 代理的情况下，为目标对象的 MBean/MXBean 接口构建一个 JMX 1.2 StandardMBean，并将接口的管理操作委托给代理。

items.source: Indicates whether Spring should ensure that ObjectNames generated by the configured ObjectNamingStrategy for runtime-registered MBeans (registerManagedResource(Object)) should get modified: to ensure uniqueness for every instance of a managed Class.
items.translation: 指示 Spring 是否应确保由配置的ObjectNamingStrategy为运行时注册的 MBeans（registerManagedResource(Object)）生成的ObjectNames进行修改：以确保每个受管理的Class实例的唯一性。
